messages:
Maya: Heads-up — our SLO alerts show a spike in routing fallbacks this morning. Customers see 503s but console flags them as "degraded routing". We should decide a single canonical mapping so clients and console align.
Ajay: Agreed. Current behavior is inconsistent: sometimes we return 503, sometimes 429, sometimes 502 depending on where the failure bubbled up. We need a table.
Sophie: Quick proposal:
- capacity/unavailable (no compatible backend) => 503 + header `X-Redwood-Fallback: capacity` + body code `capacity_unavailable`
- quota exceeded => 429 + `Retry-After` when available + body code `quota_exceeded`
- transient internal (worker OOM/crash) => 502 + body code `internal_transient`
Also include `X-Redwood-Retry-Hint: retryable|no-retry|defer` so SDKs can behave predictably.
Maya: Important: telemetry must include `route_reason` tag and `client_retryable` boolean in traces so we can measure impact of exposing retry hints. Also console needs a friendly line: "Actionable: reduce concurrency or pin to dedicated" when it's capacity.
Ajay: If we add headers SDKs will parse them, so this is a public contract — we should version it: add `X-Redwood-Client-V: 1`. New mapping can be rolled out under the versioned header.
Oliver: For rollouts, can we canary this mapping to 10% of customers? We need metrics: `client_retries_by_reason` and `retry_success_rate` to detect bad retry loops.
Sophie: One more UX point: in response body include small machine field `{"code":"capacity_unavailable", "hint":"retryable"}` but keep it minimal to avoid payload bloat. Console can expand it for admins.
Maya: Security/PII note: do not expose region or hostnames in public error body. Console (admin view) can show `region` and `pool_id` behind auth.
infra-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout job created: `routes/mapping-v1` -> test cluster. Scheduled deploy: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. CI: ✅, Perf tests: pending.
Ajay: For docs/SDKs: add parsing examples and fallback-safe code snippet. Suggest to SDKs: if `X-Redwood-Retry-Hint==retryable` then exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries.
Sophie: Small mapping table to include in the RFC (quick):
```
client-facing status | body.code              | X-Redwood-Retry-Hint | telemetry.route_reason
---------------------|-------------------------|-----------------------|----------------------
503                  | capacity_unavailable    | retryable             | capacity
429                  | quota_exceeded          | no-retry / deferrable | quota
502                  | internal_transient      | retryable             | worker_fail
500                  | internal_unclassified   | no-retry              | unknown
```
Maya: Can we avoid adding new status codes? Keep standard HTTP codes but standardize the body.code values — that will help i18n in console too.
Oliver: I'll open an RFC + epic and wire RD-7123 to track the rollout + SDK changes. Can we aim for PR by EOD Thu?
Ajay: +1. I'll own the SDK examples.
Maya: Thanks all — cheers :thumbsup:
